name: Acme Desk
notes:
Acme Desk is a Mac app, not a website. Teams use it to manage their Acme projects, teammates and workspace settings.

- A "path" here is a screen of the app, named after the window's title. The sidebar on the left switches screens: Overview, Projects, Team, Settings.
- Menu bar items are listed as elements too. One marked "in the closed File menu" is reached by opening that menu first. Point at the item itself: the app moves the pointer to the menu's title until the menu is open.
- Settings has three tabs: General, Notifications and Security. API keys are on the Security tab.
- Exports are in the File menu, under Export.

docs.title: Inviting teammates
docs.text:
# Inviting teammates

Open Team in the sidebar and press Invite teammate. Type the person's email address, choose a role and press Send invite.
